title: Curl stdin installer fails from Node projects with package.json
description: Evidence: README advertises curl | bash install; install.sh derives script_dir from the stdin caller directory, skips GitHub bootstrap when $script_dir/package.json exists, then requires $script_dir/apps/cli/dist/index.js. Reproduced from /private/tmp containing only package.json: missing bundled CLI at .../apps/cli/dist/index.js. Impact: documented no-checkout install fails when run from a normal Node repo.
acceptanceCriteria: stdin/curl install reliably bootstraps from GitHub regardless of caller package.json, with an install-sh regression fixture for a host directory containing package.json.
